body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW27wHwh6evB3MBjiu2K2XyU8)_

## Merge order

- Base: `main`; no dependency.
- Branch is named `469-...` but this is PR #470 (469 was taken meanwhile; a cloud session cannot rename a branch).
- **Conflicts with #468** (open): both change `sp-batch-report.el` and its `.org` (hints, `k` key). Merge this one first; the conflict is in the hints list and the `sp-batch-report-open` body, so #468 then needs a small rebase (keep its `k` hint in `sp-batch-report--hints`).

## Why the hints never appeared

- **Main cause:** #459 was stacked on `457-echo-area-help-hints`. #457 had already been merged into `main`, so #459 was merged into that old branch only. Its 15 changed files never reached `main`: no report buffer called `sp-echo-help-set`, and the key lines stayed in the header, the buffers and the footers.
- **Second cause (found while testing):** even with #459 applied, the hints could stay hidden.
  - `sp-batch-report-open` set them before `pop-to-buffer`, so the buffer was not yet in the selected window and nothing was shown at once.
  - `sp-echo-help-show` is polite and skips when a message is in the echo area. The last message of a job ("done", "cancelled") stays there, so neither the post-command nor the idle show ever fired.

## Changes

- Cherry-picked the two commits of #459 (`a47a438`, `cb04b22`) onto `main`: batch report, footnote lint, litnote status, author notes (new and old view), tag lint, backlink check, graph view, with their docs.
- `sp-batch-report-open` sets the hints after `pop-to-buffer`, so they show immediately.
- `sp-echo-help--idle-show` now replaces a message that has stayed for the whole idle delay (the post-command show stays polite).
- Docs updated as bullets (`sp-batch-report.org`, `sp-interaction.org`); no CHANGELOG edit; `when-let*` only.

## Tests (Emacs 29.3, batch)

- `sp-batch-report-test`: 21 pass; `sp-echo-help-test`: 7 pass.
- New tests that fail without the fix (checked):
  - `sp-batch-report-open-shows-hints-in-the-real-path`: runs `sp-batch-report-open`, checks no `header-line-format`, hints set, mode on, hook installed, and the hints printed (`Apply`, `Quit`).
  - `sp-batch-report-hints-survive-a-lingering-message`: with a message in the echo area the idle show still prints the hints.
  - `sp-echo-help-idle-show-replaces-a-message`.
  - `sp-batch-report-no-key-lines-in-header-code`: static check of the converted modules.

## Not tested by Claude

- Everything in a real GUI with your theme, vault and `sp-globals` (author notes, tag lint, footnote lint, litnote status, backlink check, graph view): their tests need your environment. Only syntax (`check-parens`) was checked.
- How the 2-row grid fits a narrow frame.
- Whether the idle re-show feels too eager when you read a message for more than 1.5 s (`sp-echo-help-idle-delay`).

## Manual testing

- [x] `cd ~/dotfiles; git fetch origin 469-echo-help-reach-main; git checkout 469-echo-help-reach-main`, restart Emacs (or `M-x sp-reload-modules`)
- [x] `M-x sp-author-notes`: no keys in the header line or at the bottom; the echo area shows the hint grid (`Apply`, `Quit` bold) once the report opens
- [ ] Wait 2 s after the "done" message: the hints are back in the echo area
- [ ] In the report press `d` on an entry: the "dropped" message shows, and the hints return after the idle delay or the next command
- [x] `C-c ?` in the report shows the hints at once
- [ ] `M-x sp-litnotes-titles-dryrun`, tag lint, BibTeX lint: same checks
- [ ] `M-x sp-org-lint-footnotes-dryrun`: header only progress while scanning, full hints when done
- [ ] `M-x sp-litnotes-meta-status-report`: counts in the header, hints in the echo area
- [ ] `sp-vulpea-backlink-check` and the relationship graph view: title only, hints in the echo area
- [x] Switch to another buffer: no stray hints there
- [ ] Regression: `RET`, `n`, `p`, `d`, `u`, `A`, `g`, `q` still work

<details><summary>Revert after testing</summary>

- `git -C ~/dotfiles status`, then `git -C ~/dotfiles restore .` for local edits.
- `git -C ~/dotfiles switch main && git -C ~/dotfiles pull`, then restart Emacs or `M-x sp-reload-modules`.
- Optionally `git -C ~/dotfiles branch -D 469-echo-help-reach-main`.
- The dry runs only read the vault; no vault restore needed.

</details>
